verdict.rationale: Wrike documents a first-party Batch API that runs multiple operations asynchronously in a single request, which directly provides bulk operations across many items. The evidence is a single brief mention with no detail on scope, limits, or which item types and operations are covered. Missing for 10: documented batch size limits and supported operation types, UI or natural-language bulk-edit evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: The Batch API lets you execute multiple operations asynchronously in a single request to reduce API calls and rate-limit pressure.
